summary: Einride AB furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a September 30, 2026 amendment to its December 9, 2024 invoice purchase agreement with Norra Finans Sverige AB. The amendment raises the credit limit from SEK 550 million to SEK 650 million and adds U.S. subsidiary Einride Logistics Inc. as a party. All other terms remain unchanged. The filing is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; there is no price, stake, premium, board recommendation or advisor. No deal terms apply.
